rule: Three rules. (A) Picker: Dice100 roll; 1-80 gives a level window [L-3, L+3] clipped to the list (low edge below 0 snaps to [0,5], high edge above 19 snaps to [14,19]); 81-95 gives [0, L+1]; 96-100 gives [0,19], or [0, L+2] when L<=5; then a uniform pick. Tables are per place (dungeon type, climate day/night, building). (B) Cadence: one roll per elapsed game minute, only in 12 of every 144 game minutes; roll 1-in-36 outdoors by day, 1-in-24 outdoors by night and in town at night, town by day never; dungeon only while resting and alerted (1-in-36), else never; a spawn ends the catch-up pass. The world clock runs at 12 game seconds per real second, so one game minute is 5 real seconds. (C) Placement and alert: a ray from the player at the view angle plus 0-4 degrees on a random side; wall hit backs off by separation 1.25 divided by the wall-normal cosine; no hit places a point between min and max distance; floor probe 4 units; empty sphere 0.65 at 1.25 above floor; retry each frame, no cap. Alert is raised while a targeting enemy sees the player, cleared when that enemy dies, decays after 480 game minutes. Quest grammar: create foe SYMBOL every N minutes M times with P percent success; interval N*60 game seconds; first spawn phase-randomised; each interval one P roll, failed rolls do not use up M; one group in flight; send form waits for the town rect. Guards: after a crime, guard NPCs within 77.5 units are switched off and replaced; a non-guard citizen behind the player may become a guard at 1-in-4; fallback 2-5 guards in a spawner at 12.8-51.2 units; indoor burst 2-5; cap of 5 active.

look_test: One scene flag, no release rows. Three presets, one minute of walking each: (A) spawn 8-20 units inside the view cone; (B) spawn in an out-of-view ring using the phone horizontal angle; (C) B with 1-3 members rolled, against a fixed 3. Dom judges on his phone at 375 wide: is the first sight of B a surprise or a pop; can a 3-member group read as one threat; does C feel like a patrol or a mob; how many encounters per minute of walking at each preset. Target file: src/fight/encounter-template.ts (row 4).
